name.la: Vitis mystica seu tractatus de passione Domini

description.la: Tractatus de passione Domini sub figura vitis, in viginti quattuor capitibus: de proprietatibus vitis, foliis, floribus et fructu. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Decem opuscula, 1900), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A treatise on the Lord’s Passion under the figure of the vine, in twenty-four chapters: its properties, leaves (the seven words on the cross), flowers and fruit. The Latin is the Quaracchi text of the Decem opuscula (1900), from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Tratado sobre a Paixão do Senhor sob a figura da videira, em vinte e quatro capítulos: suas propriedades, folhas (as sete palavras na cruz), flores e fruto.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Decem opuscula ad theologiam mysticam spectantia, ed. 2 (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1900).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR of the octavo edition. Page heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings and cross-references) and note markers are removed; line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by comparison with the other Quaracchi scans, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1900 is public domain.
